significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish that an aligned model's harmfulness judgment is a "sum of two causally separable contributions" whose relative weighting explains two distinct failures: lexical dominance causes over-refusal, while weak lexical evidence despite strong semantic intent enables jailbreaks. This is a form-(ii) causal decomposition of a nominally unitary safety signal into independently manipulable contributors, augmented by a form-(iii) ordering and predictive coupling—"shallow lexical-trigger" versus "deep semantic-intent" activity predicts opposite error classes—and it would constrain when scalar refusal-direction accounts such as Arditi et al.'s 2024 refusal-direction result are inadequate. It establishes both a behavioral phenomenon and a mechanism; a negative result would informatively rule out the proposed common-axis explanation and its promised simultaneous repair, although it would not distinguish among all alternative jailbreak mechanisms. Verified-true and verified-false states are determinate, and the topic-substitution check passes: deleting this two-contributor, two-failure decomposition leaves only generic mechanistic LLM safety, which would not warrant this score.

reach.justification: The named handle is "Semantic-Recompute," an inference-time intervention that "estimates the lexical-trigger contribution ... and subtracts it," together with measurable lexical and semantic projections that can diagnose which side of the proposed confound a prompt occupies. It is ex ante because it modifies the safety decision before generation, leaving an action window for deployment, and the stated downstream users are deployers seeking "fewer harmless refusals and less moderation burden without a separate jailbreak-hardening pass." Although directions require per-model calibration, the claimed quadrant relation—over-refusals as high-lexical/low-semantic and jailbreaks as low-lexical/high-semantic—predicts what re-extraction should recover across aligned models rather than merely supplying an open-ended search procedure; scope is nevertheless short of universal because the claim acknowledges jailbreaks driven by other mechanisms and adaptive semantic attacks. The topic-substitution check passes: generic safety interpretability supplies neither this joint diagnostic nor a single pre-output intervention usable by auditors or deployers.
